name: D. Kalacheva
evidence: Queries: 'Калачева Клокова ВШЭ лаборатория лингвистической конфликтологии email контакты' and '"Калачева Дарья" ВШЭ staff hse.ru email телефон'. The shared-paper query first established the full author list of 'Cultural Evaluation of LLMs in Russian: Catchphrases and Cultural Types' (Dialogue 2025): Elizaveta Gromenko, Daria Kalacheva, Ksenia Klokova, Maxim Krongauz, Oksana Moroz - i.e. D. Kalacheva = Daria Kalacheva, HSE Laboratory of Linguistic Conflictology circle. No hse.ru staff page and no address for her surfaced; results returned only unrelated HSE staff named Daria. The conference PDF (dialogue-conf.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/GromenkoEetal.029.pdf), which carries the author contact block, returned proxy 403 (egress-blocked), so it could not be read. Nothing verbatim to accept.
